scenario: LCCO.8.4 — `error` is the only name an `error:` body has for the matched CallError, so `{err.code}` is a read of an unbound name, DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING. The outer rule binds only `t`, so nothing else could supply `err`. Drives the same continuation-scope resolution as LCCO.8.4_error_binding_reads, on the refusing side.
rules_ds:
service sensor.read:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call sensor.read entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 1_min
        error:
            log info "call failed: {err.code}"
